description.en: Class 9 science: atoms, mixtures, cells, tissues, motion and forces, living things, reproduction, sound, and work and energy. Each lesson has things to try, short questions and review games. Works offline.

blurb.en: Nine Class 9 science modules, from atoms and cells to motion, sound and energy.

highlights.en: Move, zoom and test things in more than 300 small simulations
Guess first, then see what really happens
Short questions after each idea, with a hint when you need one
Works offline once a lesson is opened
